'''2X-3KPR''' was a [[KPR security droid]] that belonged to the [[Lars family]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. In [[9 BBY]], it stood outside the [[Lars homestead|Lars Homestead]] on alert conditions when the former [[Inquisitor]] [[Reva Sevander]] arrived in search of the Lars's adopted son, [[Luke Skywalker]]. [[Standard year|Years]] later in [[1 BBY]], the [[droid]] rolled past Skywalker and the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]] as they searched for the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] outside the homestead.

==Biography==
2X-3KPR<ref name="KenobiVITrivia" /> was a [[KPR security droid]] that belonged to the [[Lars family]],<ref name="ANH" /> who used it as a [[BT-16 perimeter droid|perimeter droid]]<ref name="KenobiVITrivia" /> at their [[Lars homestead|homestead]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="ANH" /> In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="KenobiDate">{{KenobiDate|I}}</ref> the droid stood stationary outside the homestead with it's dome lit yellow when the [[Jedi]]-in-hiding [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] approached the structure and left a toy [[T-16 skyhopper]] outside for [[Luke Skywalker]], the adopted son of the homestead's owners, [[Owen Lars]] and [[Beru Whitesun Lars|Beru Lars]].<ref name="KenobiI">{{Kenobi|Part I}}</ref> It was also stood outside the house lit yellow on another night,<ref name="KenobiV">{{Kenobi|Part V}}</ref> shortly before Owen learned that the former [[Inquisitor]] [[Reva Sevander]] was on Tatooine searching for Skywalker.<ref name="KenobiVI">{{Kenobi|Part VI}}</ref>

Knowing Reva would come to the homestead,<ref name="KenobiVI" /> Owen and Beru prepared for attack and set 2X-3KPR on alert conditions that it announced by having its warning dome lit red.<ref name="KenobiVITrivia" /> When Reva did arrive that night she passed the red-lit droid outside the homestead, after which a perimeter alarm sounded within the homestead, warning Owen and Beru of Reva's approach. After Reva fought her way past his [[parent]]s, Skywalker fled from the homestead past 2X-3KPR. By the [[time]] Kenobi arrived to help Beru and Owen search for Luke, the [[droid]] had moved from the spot where it had stood stationary.<ref name="KenobiVI" />

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="ANHDate">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> the droid rolled passed Skywalker and the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]] as Skywalker used his [[macrobinoculars]] to search for the missing [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] in the [[Standard day|night]]. The next day, Skywalker and C-3PO left the homestead to search for R2-D2, after which [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s arrived searching for C-3PO and R2-D2. The Imperials [[Death|killed]] Owen and Beru, prompting Skywalker to depart Tatooine<ref name="ANH" /> and leave the homestead abandoned for many [[Standard year|years]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
2X-3KPR first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]<ref name="ANH" /> in a scene filmed on [[March 22]], [[1976]] at the homestead set in the salt flats of [[Wikipedia:Nefta, Tunisia|Nefta]], [[Wikipedia:Tunisia|Tunisia]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> The droid was first identified in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was named as "2X-3KPR" on a card in the [[1995]] [[Premiere Limited]] set of cards for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] made by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=2X-3KPR}}</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the [[StarWars.com]] episode guide for the [[Part III|third episode]] of the [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] television series confirmed that perimeter droid seen in the show was the same one seen in ''A New Hope''. The guide identified the droid as "2X-K3PR;" however, as it also explicitly stated that the droid's designation originated on the Decipher card,<ref name="KenobiVITrivia" /> this article assumes 2X-K3PR to be a typo and that the original Legends spelling is correct.
